lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Dominican Republic through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset contains approximately 230.8 thousand buildings with structural attributes (type, levels, materials) and address information derived from crowdsourced mapping contributions, with an average data age of 3 years and 7% of features updated within the last 6 months.
